title: Thomson problem, N = 7, logarithmic energy: computational certificates and Lean formalisation
description: An AI-produced warrant (a machine-checked Lean proof that no human has digested); the conjecture is not regarded as settled by it, and a human-readable treatment is welcome. Exact certificates, checkers and a Lean 4 formalisation directed at the statement that the regular pentagonal bipyramid minimises the logarithmic energy of seven distinct points on the unit sphere, uniquely up to an orthogonal map and a relabelling (Armentano et al., Conjecture 1). For the Riesz s = 2 energy of the same configuration the repository contains exact certificates and a Lean 4 formalisation checked by the Lean kernel (standard axioms). Not peer reviewed.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Produced by AI models (Claude Opus 5.5; reviews by Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.1 and gpt-6-astra) under the direction of the repository owner; see AI_DISCLOSURE.md. The supporting Lean library uses declarations of huwngtran/thomson-n7-lean (commit 25f2fa5); unchanged declarations are regenerated from that repository by lean/regen.sh and are not stored here.
